desc: Read N, A, B, C from stdin.
Compute S0 = sum(C[i] for i where A[i]==1).
Build P = [C[i] for i where A[i]==0 and B[i]==1] and M = [C[i] for i where A[i]==1 and B[i]==0].
Compute prefix sums of M and P, then answer = (len(M)+len(P))*S0 - len(P)*sum(M) - sum(prefix_M) + sum(prefix_P).
Print the answer and verify with sample inputs.
